task: Adopt the OpenForge research evidence standard and capture safe, machine-readable verification outcomes

events.summary: Scoped implementation to Narwhal's prospective evidence contract, regression-test recording, and CI artifact retention; existing historical evidence remains in the OpenForge portfolio catalog

Confirmed the existing research README had no versioned prospective schema or recorder; the source regression JSON report also contains free-form check descriptions that must not be published as evidence
Added the versioned JSONL schema and recorder, integrated measured static-regression outcomes with Make and CI, and bounded the CI evidence artifact retention
Closed the evidence privacy gap by extracting only allowlisted summary counts from the regression report; free-form per-check descriptions are not copied into the public artifact

events.scope: Regression report summary extraction and public evidence redaction
events.summary: A fixture containing a token-like check description produced only pass/fail/warning counts in JSONL and marked the run failed when the report contained a failure

events.scope: Evidence recorder success/failure handling, report-summary sanitization, JSON Schema, docs, and mutable workflow input pinning
events.summary: Five recorder unit tests passed; JSON Schema validated successful and failed records; markdownlint, workflow YAML parse, and the mutable-input guard passed

Local static regression still reports the unrelated existing R55 portal OIDC parser failure (207 pass, 1 fail, 1 warning); both observed runs remain recorded as failed JSONL rows without raw descriptions

The first hosted trace evaluator run rejected the initial trace because a failed baseline observation was modeled as a verification event and the task outcome conflicted with its completion claim; the trace was revised to classify facts and scoped verification separately
The evidence schema, safe recorder, static-regression integration, CI artifact path, and regression tests are implemented; unrelated R55 remains explicitly measured and separate
The scoped evidence collection implementation is complete and locally verified; hosted PR CI is the final merge gate
